claims.claim: Perfectly refurbished standing Gas cooker in perfect working condition.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a 4-burner gas cooker with oven and glass door, but does not show ignition/flame test, leak check, or oven heating/controls working.

risks.risk: Gas compatibility/connection type is unclear (LPG vs natural gas) because the regulator/hose is not clearly shown.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the gas inlet/regulator label and the hose/regulator connection (including any LPG/Natural gas marking).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used gas cooker with unknown gas compatibility; treat as needing verification before full use.

risks.risk: Burners may not ignite properly or may have weak/uneven flame; no flame/ignition test is shown.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing each of the 4 burners lighting (one-by-one) with visible steady flame.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working; assume possible burner ignition issues.

risks.risk: Potential gas leaks or faulty valves/regulators; no leak test is shown.
risks.proof: A clip showing a leak test result (e.g., soapy water bubbles at joints) and/or proof of regulator integrity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as safety-uncertain; assume it may require servicing.

risks.risk: Oven may not heat correctly or controls/thermostat may be faulty; only the door/glass is visible.
risks.proof: A video showing the oven turning on and heating (temperature setting change and visible heat/indicator behavior).
risks.if_unproven: Price as oven performance unverified; assume oven may need repair.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues (dents, rust, missing parts, cracks in glass/door) are not clearly verifiable from the provided angle.
risks.proof: Clear photos of all sides, especially around the oven door edges, glass, burner caps, and control panel for cracks/rust/dents.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic/parts condition for a used unit.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (tray/rack, extra burner caps/spares) could reduce value.
risks.proof: A photo inventory showing included items: oven tray, rack(s), burner caps/spares, and any manuals/warranty.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories may be incomplete.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the gas inlet and regulator/hose connection (showing LPG/Natural gas compatibility markings).
Record a short video lighting all 4 burners one-by-one with steady flame visible.
Show a leak test at the joints/regulator (soapy water bubbles or equivalent).
Record a short video of the oven turning on and heating (thermostat/indicator behavior).
Provide photos of the full unit from multiple angles, focusing on oven glass/door edges, burner caps, and any rust/dents.
List and show included accessories (oven tray/rack(s), burner caps/spares) and whether any warranty/receipt exists.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies it as a 4-burner standing gas cooker with an oven and glass door, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition; however, working status and safety checks are not shown, so the price should reflect unverified performance.
